mapper.sql: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class visible_class JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = h.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 AND visible_course.status = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 AND visible_binding.status = 0 WHERE visible_class.id = h.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND visible_class.status = 0 AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))
AND (h.status IN (1, 2) OR (h.status = 3 AND hr.id IS NOT NULL))
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.homework_name AS homeworkName, h.homework_type AS homeworkType, h.homework_level AS homeworkLevel, COALESCE(h.indicator_first_id, 0) AS indicatorFirstId, h.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, h.deadline, h.score, h.pass_score AS passScore, hr.id AS recordId, COALESCE(hr.status, 0) AS status, hr.score AS myScore, hr.redo_deadline AS redoDeadline, 10 AS historyOnly FROM edu_homework h INNER JOIN edu_homework_assignee ha ON ha.homework_id = h.id AND ha.student_id = #{studentId} AND ha.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN edu_homework_record hr ON hr.homework_id = h.id AND hr.student_id = #{studentId} AND hr.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = h.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 INNER JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = h.class_id AND ec.deleted = 0 AND ec.status = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0
AND NOT (h.status IN (1, 2) )
AND h.status IN (1, 2)
AND h.course_id = #{courseId}
AND hr.id IS NULL
AND hr.status = #{status}
ORDER BY h.id DESC
